channel.title: USA AI Monitor
channel.description: AI monitoring of US political, economic and security developments

item.title: Dennis Hastert, longtime Republican House speaker who went to prison, dies at age 84
item.description: ennis Hastert, whose political legacy as Congress' longest-serving Republican House speaker was later fouled by allegations that he had molested high school athletes during his prior career as a teacher and wrestling coach, has died, a coroner said Monday. He was 84.

item.title: Imran Khan supporters march in Pakistan to demand his release after talks failed
item.description: Talks between Khan's party and the government failed two days ago. Besides Khan's release, protesters demand his transfer to a hospital and family visits.

item.title: SCOTUS hears major climate change case. And, Brazil's presidential race goes to runoff
item.description: The Supreme Court is set to hear a blockbuster climate change case that could affect more than just climate issues. And, Brazil's presidential race is too close to call.

item.title: Spain's prime minister calls early elections as pressure mounts over housing crisis
item.description: Spanish Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez announced early elections Monday after his government suffered a bruising legislative defeat last week on emergency measures related to the country's housing crisis.

item.title: Former Prince Andrew's historic police showdown could put seized evidence in jeopardy: expert
item.description: Andrew Mountbatten-Windsor's legal challenge targets Thames Valley Police searches of his homes, potentially undermining key evidence in the Epstein probe.

item.title: AEW star Pac had medication in backpack, saliva on shirt at death scene, police report says
item.description: A police report reveals Benjamin Satterley, known as Pac, was found unresponsive in his vehicle in Illinois with medication in his backpack.

item.title: Teen's hand blown off by police grenade during French student protests: report
item.description: A 15-year-old lost his hand after picking up a police grenade as French school protests over underfunding and teacher shortages enter their third week.

item.title: The Bills and Patriots are talking trash about each other and the verbal joust is very entertaining
item.description: C.J. Gardner-Johnson dismissed Efton Chism's one-handed touchdown catch as a practice squad play, but Mike Vrabel fired back with a cutting response.

item.title: Paxton vents over lack of campaign control as DC establishment he once battled comes to his aid
item.description: Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton says he feels less control over his campaign than ever as he battles James Talarico in a toss-up Senate race.

item.title: Cornell University protests escalate with spray paint and broken glass
item.description: Student activists vandalized the office of senior administrators over the school’s handling of rape allegations.

item.title: 6 things to watch in the Supreme Court’s new term
item.description: Cases on religion, elections and immigration are likely to take the spotlight. And don’t forget to watch for a potential retirement.

item.title: As Trump rallies his base in Ohio, a Haitian migrant is laid to rest nearby
item.description: Mourners in Springfield, Ohio, blamed Pierre Damas Bel’s death on President Donald Trump’s deportation campaign. Trump’s supporters said ICE needs to do more.

item.title: Should Big Oil pay for climate change? A Supreme Court case will help decide.
item.description: Boulder, Colorado, is hoping its novel lawsuit will be the environmental equivalent of the landmark litigation that produced billions in damages and settlements against Big Tobacco and opioid makers.

item.title: ‘Dying on the vine’: How a farmer ended up with 1,600 tons of unwanted grapes
item.description: Falling demand for juice has left Lake Erie grape growers with fruit they can’t sell.

item.title: Republican in toss-up House race says he won’t be a ‘rubber stamp’
item.description: Rep. Juan Ciscomani also touts his immigrant roots in a new video as he seeks reelection in Arizona.

item.title: Sen. Kennedy says he’s weighing White House run: ‘Why not me on a rainy day?’
item.description: The Louisiana Republican said on “Meet the Press” that “if a bunch of goobers run ... and I think I could do a better job, I would consider running.”

item.title: How would Susan Collins approach a new Supreme Court vacancy?
item.description: The Maine senator's vote to confirm Brett Kavanaugh in 2018 is still an issue as she seeks reelection.

item.title: 6 things to watch in the Supreme Court’s new term
item.description: Cases on religion, elections and immigration are likely to take the spotlight. And don’t forget to watch for a potential retirement.

item.title: Four ways the midterm elections could go, one month away
item.description: Democrats have polls and history on their side. Republicans have money.

item.title: With threats to midterms, states say Trump administration isn’t helping
item.description: U.S. spy agencies see Russia and others plotting to sow distrust and misinformation in the upcoming elections.
